newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klestil calls off visit to Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klestil calls off visit to Ukraine.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil, recovering from acute pneumonia, has postponed a two-day official visit to Ukraine scheduled for October 22 as he still needs time to recuperate, his spokesman said on Thursday.
"A new date has not been fixed -- it obviously depends on how long it takes until he is fully fit," presidential spokesman Heinz Nussbaumer told Reuters.
Klestil, 63, was admitted to Vienna general hospital on September 14 and was transferred to intensive care when his condition deteriorated.
On Wednesday, Klestil's office said he was making a steady recovery but was not yet ready to resume his official duties.
